stops.date_confidence: reconstruction, deliberately downgraded. Wikipedia, 'Ignatius L. Donnelly' states verbatim that in 1877 he spoke to a meeting of ten thousand where he read his preamble to the People's Party conference platform. That is anachronistic: the People's Party did not exist until 1891-92 and his famous preamble is the Omaha Platform preamble of 4 July 1892. His 1877 vehicle was the Anti-Monopoly and Greenback movement. The crowd and the preamble-reading are kept, the party name is dropped. Location within Minnesota is not given by the source; the pin is St. Paul. Month and day unknown and defaulted.
